integrity: All asserted finite histogram multiplicities are reproducible from two embedded exact-arithmetic programs; all-length claims have a written proof independent of computation.
scientific_limitations: All-length results concern the two abelian palette groups of order four and wheel graphs with at least three rim vertices. Exact magnitude histograms are claimed at the first separating rim length, not for arbitrary lengths. Priority comparisons are bounded; independent audit not performed.
title: Four-colour wheel convolution: universal Fourier support and a six-rim group-law distinction
